content.overview: Articles 14–18 protect equality: equality before law (14); non-discrimination and special provisions (15); equality of opportunity and reservations (16); abolition of untouchability (17); abolition of titles (18).
content.study: Article 14 permits reasonable classification. Articles 15–16 have prohibitions and enabling clauses — read the specific clause. Article 17 has horizontal reach. Cross-read constitution-art-* for clause text.

sections.heading: Article 14 test
sections.body: Class, differentia, object, nexus; then arbitrariness.

sections.heading: Articles 15–16
sections.body: Plead the correct enabling clause for reservations; do not invent percentage ceilings.
